adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly removes the Disqus CLI `-c/--category` option (`lib/tasks/disqus.thor` deletes `method_option :category`) and removes the code that computed `category_id` and passed both `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` and `category: category_id` into `PostCreator.new(...)`. It replaces that with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` / `TopicEmbed.import` do not accept or forward `created_at` or `category` into `PostCreator` (they only pass `title`, `raw`, `skip_validations`, `cook_method`). Since `PostCreator` only sets `post.created_at` when `@opts[:created_at]` is present, imported posts will default to "now", and without a category option they will fall back to whatever default category behavior is (likely uncategorized). This is a concrete behavior regression introduced by the diff.
